proposed.proposedOwner: Material audit local versus retained inherited text font-family
proposed.justification: Original own-text inheritance paths and separately retained core-text family agree with browser computed family, while candidate local declarations omit it. This explains the measurement-stage discrepancy only; physical font selection, loading, fallback, glyph paint, layout and other properties remain unproven.
